completion_mode: tag-pinned elan lean/lake resolver and EnvironmentLockRecord executable_paths; not a lake compile and not a scored Arena run

criteria.criterion: Resolver returns tag-pinned elan lean and lake paths from JSONL version_info.
criteria.explanation: LeanToolchainResolver.resolve_version_info parsed every warm-up JSONL version_info entry (15 records, 36 pins, 10 unique tags) under frozen digest 6209680cf00cde0765b77b24834cd72c64dd585b2f7e3f2a58209980ab59a804. Each pin is {ELAN_HOME}/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---<tag>/bin/{lean,lake}. Self-check reported all_pins_tag_pinned=true and unique_tags_match=true for v4.25.0 through v4.33.0-rc2. AST audit found no shutil.which, find_executable, glob, or newest-mtime selection. A private fake elan home resolved v4.26.0 and v4.32.0 to those exact tag directories with PATH emptied; a missing v4.25.0 tag raised LeanToolchainMissing instead of falling back. Default HOME has no installed elan binaries (capability gap); paths remain tag-pinned and this task did not treat PATH lean as usable.

criteria.criterion: EnvironmentLockRecord is populated via executable_paths, not primary_executable.
criteria.explanation: environment_lock constructs EnvironmentLockRecord(executable_paths={'lean': tag_lean, 'lake': tag_lake}) and never calls build_environment_lock or passes primary_executable. dataclasses.fields(EnvironmentLockRecord) has executable_paths and no primary_executable; lock.to_dict() likewise omits that field. Self-check set environment_lock_has_primary_executable=false, any_lock_used_primary_executable=false, and the synthetic v4.26.0 lock recorded lock_executable_paths for lean and lake only. Kernel command template is '{lake} env {lean} --json {source_file}'.

criteria.criterion: LeanFrontend PATH lean --json behavior is unchanged.
criteria.explanation: lean.py was not edited. AST of LeanFrontend.snapshot_goal still calls run_bounded_process with --json and does not call run_lean_process or lake. capability() still uses find_executable on PATH. lean.py does not import lean_toolchain. Self-check lean_frontend.unchanged_path_lean_json=true. Compile workers are directed to run_lean_process on the tag-pinned paths; this task does not make snapshot_goal lake-aware.

source_versions.model_or_solver_experiment: none; cpu-medium tag-pinned elan resolver only, no live Leanstral completion, no lake compile, no Arena scores

limitations: No elan toolchains are installed under the resolver elan home (Path.home()/.elan or ELAN_HOME). All 10 warm-up tags resolve to tag-pinned paths with installed=false. That is a recorded capability gap, not PATH lean usability and not a lake compile.

Authoritative validation uses a sealed PATH (/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin) and a fresh HOME named ipfs-accelerate-validation-home-*; operator ~/.elan is unavailable there as well.
Synthetic elan-home fixtures prove tag pinning and fail-closed missing-tag behavior without executing Lean or lake.
/tmp is noexec in this environment; installed detection uses execute-mode bits, not os.access(X_OK).
LeanFrontend.snapshot_goal was not modified and is still PATH lean --json via run_bounded_process. A lake-aware frontend is out of scope.
No Arena scores, token-savings percentages, or official Track 1/Track 2 rankings were produced.
This task did not call Leanstral, did not LOCK_EX, did not start llama-server, and did not bake oleans.
